pillars.title: Operational Excellence

criteria.statement: Infrastructure & operations defined as code (no manual console drift).
criteria.notes: 7 chained Terraform modules; secret values set out-of-band but documented/expected, not drift.

criteria.statement: CI/CD pipeline exists with automated build/test/deploy stages.
criteria.notes: No .github/workflows/ found; deployment fully manual; README explicitly flags CI as 'à faire'.

criteria.statement: Deployments are small, reversible; rollback strategy defined.
criteria.notes: Digest pinning + image retention enable manual rollback, but no documented rollback procedure.

criteria.statement: Structured, centralized logging (correlation ids, no secrets in logs).
criteria.notes: Gap: no API Gateway access logging (see OPS-F5).

criteria.statement: Metrics on the golden signals (latency, traffic, errors, saturation).
criteria.notes: Saturation weakly covered (queue depth dashboarded, not alarmed).

criteria.statement: Distributed tracing / request correlation where relevant.
criteria.notes: Correlation id + OTel in runtime container, but no X-Ray/OTel on ingestion Lambdas.

criteria.statement: Actionable alarms tied to SLIs; on-call/notification path defined.
criteria.notes: alarm_actions defaults to []; no SNS topic exists in-repo.

criteria.statement: Runbooks / operational docs for common tasks & incidents.
criteria.notes: DLQ triage, run tracing, secret rotation, allowlist/quota tuning, dedup troubleshooting all documented.
/ping HealthyBusy pattern, explicitly non-blocking.
Single hardcoded 'POC' environment.

criteria.statement: Automated tests as a release gate (unit/integration).
criteria.notes: Substantial test suite exists but nothing enforces it pre-deploy (no CI).
No SLI/SLO/retro/post-mortem process found.
default_tags in most modules.
6-widget CloudWatch dashboard.

strengths.text: End-to-end correlation_id threaded through webhook → SQS → worker → runtime.
100% infra-as-code across 7 chained Terraform modules.
Written runbook covering DLQ triage, run tracing, secret rotation, allowlist/quota tuning.

findings.title: No CI/CD pipeline; fully manual deployment
findings.impact: Every deploy depends on an operator running correct commands manually; no automated test/plan/apply gate.
findings.recommendation: Add a GitHub Actions pipeline: fmt/validate/pytest on PR, gated apply on merge.

alternative.summary: GitHub Actions with OIDC federation to an AWS deploy role.
cons: Chained remote-state across 7 modules needs sequencing

findings.title: Alarms exist but no notification target wired by default
findings.impact: Alarms fire into the void unless an operator manually supplies an SNS ARN; no on-call path exists.
findings.recommendation: Provision an SNS topic + subscription, default alarm_actions to it.

alternative.summary: Minimal SNS topic + email subscription in Terraform.
cons: Still requires a real on-call process

findings.title: No environment parity; single hardcoded 'POC' environment
findings.impact: No isolated environment to test infra/app changes.
findings.recommendation: Parameterize backend keys per environment, stand up a staging environment.

findings.title: Automated tests are not a release gate
findings.impact: A regression can be deployed if the manual test step is skipped.
findings.recommendation: Wire pytest into CI as a blocking check.

findings.title: No distributed tracing across the Lambda hops
findings.impact: Cross-component latency/causal analysis depends on grepping a correlation_id.
findings.recommendation: Enable AWS X-Ray active tracing on both Lambda functions.

findings.title: API Gateway stage has no access logging configured
findings.impact: Edge-level request logs not captured independently of Lambda logs.
findings.recommendation: Add access_log_settings to the $default stage.

findings.title: No post-incident / feedback loop mechanism defined
findings.impact: No structured mechanism to turn DLQ incidents into process improvements.
findings.recommendation: Define a lightweight incident log tied to the runbook.

improvements.text: Stand up a minimal CI pipeline — closes OPS-F1 and OPS-F4
Create an SNS topic + subscription and wire it as default alarm_actions — OPS-F2
Enable X-Ray active tracing on the webhook/worker Lambdas — OPS-F6
Parameterize Terraform backend per environment — OPS-F3
Add access_log_settings to the API Gateway $default stage — OPS-F5

pillars.notes: Static analysis only, live_aws=OFF. Assessed current on-disk working tree. Prior pillar-run score (82/100) treated as unverified claim per instructions; independent re-score is materially lower, mainly due to OPS-02, OPS-07, OPS-10 not being verifiable as Met.

pillars.title: Security

criteria.statement: Least-privilege IAM (no wildcard * actions/resources without justification).
criteria.notes: Webhook/worker policies tightly scoped with conditions; Bedrock InvokeModel resource wildcards across all models/regions.

criteria.statement: No long-lived credentials/secrets in code or state; use of Secrets Manager/SSM/roles.
criteria.notes: GitHub App short-lived tokens preferred.

criteria.statement: Encryption at rest on all data stores.
criteria.notes: AWS-managed keys (not CMK, see SEC-07).
API Gateway execute-api endpoints are TLS-only by default.
Fully public serverless design, no VPC/security groups; justified but unsegmented.

criteria.statement: No public exposure of data stores/admin surfaces unless justified.
criteria.notes: Only the webhook API is public, HMAC-gated.

criteria.statement: KMS CMK usage & key rotation where appropriate.
criteria.notes: CMK removed account-wide due to a DENY on kms:CreateKey (documented POC compromise).
Constant-time HMAC check runs before any processing.
Tar-slip/symlink protections; no shell=True anywhere.

criteria.statement: Detective controls (CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub) enabled.
criteria.notes: None found.
ECR scan_on_push + digest-pinned deploys, but Python deps unpinned.

criteria.statement: Secrets not logged; PII handling & redaction.
criteria.notes: mask_secrets redaction helper applied before logging.
hmac.compare_digest constant-time comparison.
No CI/CD pipeline exists; nothing to assess.
Distinct, minimally-scoped roles per component.

strengths.text: Recent and uncommitted IAM tightening verified on disk.
Webhook HMAC verification is constant-time and runs before any AWS access.
All data stores encrypted at rest with AWS-managed keys, correcting the prior audit's overstated 'no encryption' framing.

findings.title: Public webhook API Gateway endpoint has no WAF / L7 protection
findings.impact: Only API Gateway throttling and in-Lambda HMAC verification protect the public endpoint; no L7 filtering.
findings.recommendation: Attach an AWS WAFv2 WebACL to the HTTP API stage as defense-in-depth.

findings.title: No customer-managed KMS keys (CMK); blocked by account-level policy
findings.impact: All encryption uses AWS-owned/managed keys; documented deliberate POC compromise.
findings.recommendation: Obtain KMS permissions and re-enable kms_key_id with rotation once unblocked.

findings.title: No account/project-level detective controls (CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub)
findings.impact: No centralized, immutable audit trail; anomalous IAM changes would not be independently detected.
findings.recommendation: Enable a baseline CloudTrail trail and metric filters/alarms on IAM/Secrets Manager access.

findings.title: Bedrock model-invoke permission scoped wider than models actually used
findings.impact: Runtime role can invoke any foundation model in any region.
findings.recommendation: Scope the BedrockInvoke Resource to the specific model ARNs/region used.

findings.title: Unpinned Python dependencies, no lockfile
findings.impact: Builds are not reproducible; may silently pick up vulnerable dependency versions.
findings.recommendation: Pin exact versions or use a lockfile; add pip-audit/Dependabot.

improvements.text: Enable a baseline CloudTrail trail plus metric filters/alarms (SEC-F3)
Attach AWS WAFv2 to the public webhook API Gateway stage (SEC-F1)
Scope Bedrock InvokeModel resource to configured model ARNs (SEC-F4)
Pin Python dependency versions and add vulnerability scanning (SEC-F5)
Reintroduce customer-managed KMS keys once unblocked (SEC-F2)

pillars.notes: Static analysis only. Prior run's SEC-F1 (Critical) was independently re-verified: the no-WAF condition still holds but is downgraded to Medium; the 'no encryption at rest' framing was found inaccurate. No Critical findings identified; no maturity capping from this pillar.

pillars.title: Reliability

criteria.statement: No critical single points of failure.
criteria.notes: Fully-managed AWS services, inherently multi-AZ.

criteria.statement: Defined RTO/RPO and a backup strategy meeting them.
criteria.notes: No RTO/RPO figure found anywhere.

criteria.statement: Backups exist, are encrypted, and restore is tested/testable.
criteria.notes: DynamoDB PITR + S3 versioning/KMS present; no restore-test evidence.
Conditional DynamoDB PutItem claim/release.

criteria.statement: Retries with backoff + jitter; timeouts set on all remote calls.
criteria.notes: Exponential backoff and timeouts, but no jitter term.

criteria.statement: Dead-letter / failure isolation for async processing.
Graceful degradation & circuit breaking on dependency failure.
criteria.notes: No circuit-breaker pattern found.
Alarms exist but no wired notification/remediation path.
In-place digest replacement, no canary/traffic-shifting.
Unit-level only.
Shared queue/worker/idempotency table across all allowlisted repos.

strengths.text: Strong idempotency design across both webhook dedup and agent-run dedup.
SQS main queue + DLQ with bounded maxReceiveCount and a dedicated dlq_not_empty alarm.

findings.title: No RTO/RPO defined and no cross-region DR strategy (mono-region)
findings.impact: A regional outage fully halts the pipeline with no defined recovery time.
findings.recommendation: Document explicit RTO/RPO; consider cross-region if risk appetite requires more.

alternative.summary: Accept mono-region with documented RTO/RPO vs. warm standby

findings.title: No circuit breaking or graceful degradation on dependency failure
findings.impact: Sustained outage continues consuming retry/Bedrock spend until DLQ.
findings.recommendation: Add a lightweight breaker/cooldown.

findings.title: CloudWatch alarms wired to no notification target by default
findings.impact: Alarms can fire with nobody notified.
findings.recommendation: Add an SNS topic + subscription.

findings.title: No safe change-management pattern for runtime/Lambda deploys
findings.impact: A bad push replaces 100% of traffic immediately.
findings.recommendation: Add Lambda aliases/traffic-shifting; document rollback.

findings.title: Retry backoff has no jitter
findings.impact: Correlated retry bursts possible.
findings.recommendation: Add a jitter term.

findings.title: No documented/tested backup-restore procedure
findings.impact: Restore capability unverified.
findings.recommendation: Add and exercise a restore runbook.

improvements.text: Document RTO/RPO; decide DR posture (REL-F1)
Wire alarms to an SNS topic (REL-F3)
Add a dependency-failure circuit breaker (REL-F2)
Add Lambda aliases / rollback runbook (REL-F4)

pillars.notes: Coverage ~85%. Prior run (score 78) re-confirmed on REL-F1 but this run scores lower after finding additional gaps its simpler grid did not surface. The uncommitted ingestion/main.tf diff (sqs:GetQueueAttributes removal) was checked and confirmed unused/no reliability impact. No Critical finding; no capping applied.

pillars.title: Performance Efficiency

criteria.notes: Serverless ARM64 + two-tier model escalation; Lambda memory hardcoded 256MB, no power-tuning evidence.

criteria.statement: Data store choice fits access patterns.
Query/index design avoids N+1, full scans, hot partitions.
criteria.notes: All single-item ops, no scans.
In-process secret cache only; no CDN/DB cache/prompt caching.

criteria.statement: Async / batching for expensive or bursty work.
Timeouts, connection pooling, and payload sizes tuned.
criteria.notes: GitHub client uses urllib per-call, no connection pooling.
Local file reads/blob creation sequential.
Not relevant — docs consumed via GitHub UI.
Measured, no documented target/SLO/alarm.
No Throttles/ConcurrentExecutions metric.
Extensive caps everywhere.

strengths.text: Two-tier LLM model selection right-sizes inference cost/latency to repo complexity.
All DynamoDB access is single-item point operations, no scans, no hot-partition risk.

findings.title: No performance target (SLO) defined for run latency, only measured
findings.impact: Latency regressions caught only by manual dashboard inspection.
findings.recommendation: Define SLO and alarm on DurationMs p90.

findings.title: Resource-utilization monitoring omits throttles/concurrency pressure
findings.impact: Worker concurrency saturation only inferable indirectly.
findings.recommendation: Add Throttles/ConcurrentExecutions and DynamoDB throttle metrics.

findings.title: Sequential local file reads and Git blob creation
findings.impact: Bounded latency cost today, doesn't parallelize as caps grow.
findings.recommendation: Parallelize with a bounded thread pool.

findings.title: No HTTP connection pooling for the GitHub client
findings.impact: Fresh TCP+TLS handshake per call.
findings.recommendation: Use a pooled HTTP client.

findings.title: No LLM prompt caching and no load/benchmark testing evidence
findings.impact: Static prompt resent in full every run; concurrent-burst behavior unverified.
findings.recommendation: Enable Bedrock prompt caching; add a bounded-concurrency load test.

improvements.text: Define latency SLO + alarm (PERF-F1)
Add throttle/concurrency metrics (PERF-F2)
Enable Bedrock prompt caching (PERF-F5)

pillars.notes: Coverage ~75%. No live AWS calls made. IAM grants dynamodb:Query no code path uses — confirmed access is point-lookup-only.

pillars.title: Terraform

criteria.statement: Remote state with locking; state not committed; sensible segmentation.
criteria.notes: No dynamodb_table or use_lockfile configured in any of the 6 S3 backends -> no locking.

criteria.statement: Provider & Terraform version constraints pinned; lock file committed.
criteria.notes: Lock files present in all 7 modules.

criteria.statement: Variables typed, described, validated; sane defaults.
criteria.notes: Zero validation{} blocks repo-wide.
2 undocumented outputs (minor).
6/7 modules fmt-clean; validate not run this session.

criteria.statement: No hardcoded account ids/regions/ARNs where variables fit.
criteria.notes: Account ID hardcoded in 6 backend blocks (Terraform language limitation).
Zero bare count usage anywhere.
prevent_destroy absent on state bucket/DynamoDB/secrets.
No static credentials, but no explicit assume_role block in provider config.

criteria.statement: CI checks for IaC if a pipeline exists.
criteria.notes: No CI pipeline exists.

findings.title: No state locking configured on any S3 backend
findings.impact: All 6 S3-backed modules can suffer concurrent-apply state corruption; deployment is manual/local with no CI gate.
findings.recommendation: Add use_lockfile=true (S3 native locking, Terraform >=1.10) to all 6 backend blocks.

alternative.summary: use_lockfile=true vs. shared DynamoDB lock table.
pros: B: works on older Terraform CLI
cons: A: needs re-init, not honored by CLI <1.10

findings.title: terraform fmt not clean (cosmetic alignment diff in ingestion/main.tf)
findings.impact: Purely cosmetic, signals no fmt gate in the workflow.
findings.recommendation: Run terraform fmt -recursive and commit.

findings.title: No CI pipeline for IaC checks; fully manual local deployment
findings.impact: No automated fmt/validate/plan/lint gate.
findings.recommendation: Add a minimal CI workflow.

findings.title: No validation blocks on any variable
findings.impact: Malformed vars surface only as late apply-time errors.
findings.recommendation: Add validation blocks to high-value variables.

findings.title: No prevent_destroy on stateful/critical resources
findings.impact: No Terraform-level safety net against accidental destroy.
findings.recommendation: Add lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } to critical resources.

improvements.text: Add S3 native locking or a DynamoDB lock table to all 6 backends (TF-F1)

pillars.notes: Both test suites were actually executed (read-only, no installs): 107 passed/1 skipped (agent, 0.15s) and 20 passed (lambdas, 0.11s). No coverage.py configured — folded into MNT-01's Partial verdict. Score (67) differs from the prior run (83) mainly because the two highest-weighted criteria (MNT-01, MNT-05) landed Partial and MNT-03 was fully Missing on direct verification — a rubric/weighting effect, not underlying-fact disagreement.
